# Zonum Precision

> One-person shop run by Jacob. Prototype and short-run CNC machining, plus fixed-scope shop software. The person who quotes a job programs, cuts and inspects it. Contact: jacob@zonumprecision.com

## Services
- [CNC machining](https://zonumprecision.com/#machining): CNC milling, 3-axis and multi-op setups, custom fixturing. 6061/7075 aluminum, steels, stainless, brass, Delrin/acetal, UHMW. Quoted from a STEP file and PDF drawing; manufacturability feedback comes in the quote, before payment.
- [Software projects](https://zonumprecision.com/#software): cleanup of AI-built apps, LinuxCNC/Fusion automation, web apps and internal tools, code review. Fixed scope, quoted per project.
- [How it works](https://zonumprecision.com/#process)
- [FAQ](https://zonumprecision.com/#faq)

## Free tools
- [Free tools index](https://zonumprecision.com/resources)
- [Fusion Free Deburr](https://github.com/jkkicks/Fusion-Free-Deburr): deburring toolpaths for Autodesk Fusion, MIT, alpha
- [cnckit](https://github.com/jkkicks/cnckit): Python framework for LinuxCNC job queues, MIT, alpha
- [Tool Library Audit](https://github.com/jkkicks/Tool-Audit): fork of jspeceng/Tool-Audit
- [Remix + Drizzle template](https://github.com/jkkicks/Remix-Drizzle-Template): starter for web apps
